speaker: Art Bell
text: From the high desert and the great American Southwest…

episode.title: Special - Millennium New Year's Special

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Remote Viewing

Father Malachi Martin, the former Jesuit and author of Hostage to the Devil, on exorcism.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Exorcism and Remote Viewing with Malachi Martin and Ed Dames

text: Art and Whitley Strieber wrote The Coming Global Superstorm together. It became the basis for the film The Day After Tomorrow.
The Quickening: Art's sense that the pace of change in the world, natural and human, was speeding up. It became his book of the same name.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - The Quickening and Open Lines

text: Art was a ham radio operator all his life. His call sign was W6OBB.
Before talk radio, Art set a record as a disc jockey in Okinawa: a single broadcast of more than 116 hours, raising money for Vietnamese refugees.
The show came from Art's home in Pahrump, Nevada, in the high desert west of Las Vegas.
The lines had names: East of the Rockies, West of the Rockies, the Wildcard Line and the First-Time Callers line.
Open Lines: no guest and no topic, just whoever got through.
Dreamland was Art's Sunday night program, given over to UFOs and the paranormal.
The bumper music that opened the show was The Chase, Giorgio Moroder's theme from Midnight Express.
Ghost to Ghost: every Halloween the lines opened for nothing but listeners' own ghost stories.
Ghost to Ghost 1993 is the earliest Halloween ghost story night in this archive.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Ghost to Ghost 1993

text: The shadow people: in 2001 the lines filled with listeners' accounts of dark human shapes at the edge of sight.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Shadow People Phenomenon

text: Gordon Michael Scallion and his map of a future United States reshaped by the earth changes he predicted.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Earth Changes Predictions

text: Sean David Morton with his predictions for the coming year.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Predictions

text: Ramona Bell, Art's wife, joined the show with travel tips.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Life of Learning with Guy Finley and Travel Tips with Ramona Bell

text: Art made a statement on the air about his sudden decision to step away from the show.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Art's Statement on Sudden Resignation

text: Art's farewell in April 2000. Mike Siegel took over Coast to Coast AM, and Art was back the next year.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Art's Farewell

text: Art's farewell as the weeknight host, closing out 2002 with listeners' predictions for the year ahead.

episode.title: Coast to Coast AM - Art's Farewell Show with Predictions

text: George Noory took over the weeknights in 2003, and Art kept hosting on weekends for several more years.
Midnight in the Desert, Art's return to the air in 2015, opened with Graham Hancock.

episode.title: Midnight in the Desert - Graham Hancock

text: Art ended Midnight in the Desert in December 2015, saying he had to put his family's safety first.
This archive runs from December 1992 to December 2015: twenty-three years from the high desert.
